title: Logos 6 opening: sixth discourse on will and generation (PG stigma)
english: Sixth discourse. On the Father’s will and the Son’s generation.
Cyril refuses to let “by will” mean the Son is a later product. Whatever is said of willing must keep the Son inside the Father’s own life, not among crafts.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
